participation.context: Came down in the nightcap, refused the laugh, and kept the custard.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Brought the custard and the question, left the roll with Pope, and did not come above the second step.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Stood on the second step and ended the talk when the custard was granted.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

relations.note: Pope takes Gaunt, and the roll stays with him
relations.quote: He had the roll last night, and Mistress Pope says he was near weeping at it.

relations.note: she holds the second step and keeps him at the foot
relations.quote: The second step is mine, Master Heminges.

story.body: You settled that Pope plays tomorrow, refused the roll and the length of the cut cue, and let the Rose have its title without a bill. You stayed at the foot of the stair.
